Time to fill lower section = (2/3) × 36 = 24 minutes.

Step 1: Calculate the total capacity of the rectangular cistern in cubic meters:
Volume = Length × Breadth × Height = 10 m × 5 m × 2 m = 100.00 m³.

Step 2: Convert cubic meters to liters (1 m³ = 1,000 liters):
Capacity = 100.00 × 1,000 = 100000 liters.

Step 3: Calculate time to fill at 500 liters per minute:
Time = Total Capacity / Flow Rate = 100000 / 500 = 200 min.
pattern: Pipe Flow Rate & Cylindrical Tank Filling Time
